s1.syndrome_frame: Acute monocular visual disturbance with optic disc swelling and retinal lesions in a young adult with a history of neurofibroma
salient_findings: Grey dot in central vision of left eye
Swollen optic disc in right eye
Parafoveal grey-white deep retinal lesion in left eye
Cotton-wool spot in posterior pole of left eye
Central scotoma in left eye
key_facts: 18-year-old Chinese woman
Known plexiform neurofibroma of the arm
No medical history, trauma, family history, smoking, coffee, tea, illicit drugs, or oral contraceptive use
Blood pressure 110/70 mmHg
Visual acuity 20/20 in right eye and 20/25 in left eye
No relative afferent pupillary defect
Mild subcapsular cataracts bilaterally
Bilateral vestibular schwannomas on brain MRI
Parasellar mass consistent with meningioma on brain MRI
Cervical extramedullary lesion on brain MRI
Normal carotid Doppler ultrasound and transthoracic echocardiography
Normal laboratory studies, including complete blood count and inflammatory markers

shortlist.label: Neurofibromatosis type 1
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has known plexiform neurofibroma and bilateral vestibular schwannomas

shortlist.label: Paracentral acute middle maculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Swept-source optical coherence tomography showed hyperreflective bands in the inner nuclear layer

shortlist.label: Optic neuritis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with acute monocular visual disturbance and optic disc swelling

shortlist.label: Neurofibroma-related optic glioma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has history of neurofibroma and presents with optic disc swelling

shortlist.label: Multiple sclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with optic neuritis and has white matter lesions on brain MRI

raw.rationale: The patient has a known plexiform neurofibroma of the arm, bilateral vestibular schwannomas, and a parasellar mass consistent with a meningioma, which are all characteristic features of Neurofibromatosis type 1.

rejected.label: Paracentral acute middle maculopathy
rejected.why: While the patient has a parafoveal grey-white deep retinal lesion consistent with paracentral acute middle maculopathy, this is not a diagnosis that explains the overall clinical picture.

rejected.label: Optic neuritis
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of optic neuritis, as the patient has no relative afferent pupillary defect and the visual acuity is relatively preserved.

rejected.label: Neurofibroma-related optic glioma
rejected.why: There is no evidence of an optic glioma on the provided imaging studies.

rejected.label: Multiple sclerosis
rejected.why: The patient's brain MRI shows no evidence of demyelinating lesions typical of multiple sclerosis, and the clinical presentation is not consistent with this diagnosis.
